answer.summary: This procedure logs rejected transactions by mapping a rejection reason code to a descriptive text and writing the record to the rejects file. It also increments a global counter for the total number of rejected transactions.
outputs: ABW_SATZ (rejected transaction record written to REJECTS file)

rules.text: Initialize the rejection record string to empty.
Map the current transaction ID to the rejection record.
Set the rejection reason code and default the description to a question mark.
If the provided rejection code matches a code in the lookup table, update the description with the corresponding text.
Write the completed rejection record to the REJECTS file.
Increment the global rejected transaction counter.
